challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #97

challenges.content: where the cultivation and expression of energy is important.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #98

challenges.content: Bear in mind too that most types of stone cost more than all but the rarest of wood.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #99

challenges.content: Of course, there is no reason why some rooms of a house should not feature wood floors or other stone tiles.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #100

challenges.content: You can even mix the two.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #101

challenges.content: A room with wood panels on the walls can have a beautiful stone floor.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #102

challenges.content: My bedroom has white birch walls and a light blue slate floor.
challenges.explanation:
birch

a type of wood

birch forest
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #103

challenges.content: The place looks like a Russian hunting lodge.
challenges.explanation:
hunting lodge

A building used for the recreational use of hunting.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #104

challenges.content: Remember, though, go with what feels right for you.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #105

challenges.content: Good taste and the "laws" of interior design are the homeowner's servants, not his master.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #106

challenges.content: It's only beautiful when you decide it is.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #107

challenges.content: I mean, you're the one who lives there, not the decorator, right?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #108

challenges.content: OK, are there any questions?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 4 - challenge #109

challenges.content: Hello... are you Professor Van Diezen?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #1

challenges.content: Yes, I am. And who might you be?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #2

challenges.content: Oh! Sorry, my name is Tina. I'm a freshman here.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #3

challenges.content: They told me I should ask you for advice in choosing courses.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #4

challenges.content: Well, that's part of what I'm here for.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #5

challenges.content: Please come in and sit down.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #6

challenges.content: Now, what are your questions?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #7

challenges.content: I, I almost don't know!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #8

challenges.content: Everything is so confusing!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #9

challenges.content: Like what is a specialised course?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #10

challenges.content: Oh, easy. A specialised course is one that is compulsory,
challenges.explanation:
compulsory

if something is compulsory, it is required or mandatory
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #11

challenges.content: meaning it's a requirement for your major and regular,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #12

challenges.content: so you can't place out by taking a proficiency exam.
challenges.explanation:
place out

to satisfy the necessary conditions to skip some required academic courses

proficiency exam

a placement exam, an exam (or test) to measure your level
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #13

challenges.content: That sounds pretty strict.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #14

challenges.content: Then what are all these general courses?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #15

challenges.content: I seem to have to take so many.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #16

challenges.content: Nothing to be alarmed over.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #17

challenges.content: These are courses open to all students and not directly related to your major.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #18

challenges.content: The university offers these general courses to choose
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #19

challenges.content: so that you can become more well-rounded individuals.
challenges.explanation:
well-rounded

if you are well-rounded, you have experience and knowledge in a number of different areas
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #20

challenges.content: For example, I see you're a Microbiology major.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #21

challenges.content: So it might be a good idea to take some literature or history courses
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #22

challenges.content: so that you can know something besides all science.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #23

challenges.content: You mean these courses are, like, for fun?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #24

challenges.content: That might be one way to look at it,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #25

challenges.content: but don't tell the literature professor such a thing.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #26

challenges.content: Think of a general course as the opposite of a specified course.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #27

challenges.content: A specified course is one that pertains directly to your major.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #28

challenges.content: So can I take any Microbiology course I want?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #29

challenges.content: Let's see.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #30

challenges.content: Oh, those courses used to be open to Microbiology students only.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #31

challenges.content: The good thing is, now it's open to students on a flexible schedule,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #32

challenges.content: so it's not only for full-time students.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #33

challenges.content: So the answer is yes, if you have the instructor's permission.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #34

challenges.content: May I ask you why you chose Microbiology?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #35

challenges.content: Well, I also like plain old Biology, too.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #36

challenges.content: You know, full sized animals.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #37

challenges.content: I might even become a veterinarian.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #38

challenges.content: Could I take some Biology classes?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #39

challenges.content: Well, they are open to full-time students only,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #40

challenges.content: which I believe is what you are.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #41

challenges.content: I don't know how a freshman would get along with Microbiology, though.
challenges.explanation:
get along with

if you get along with something, you like it
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #42

challenges.content: I mean, most of the students presently looking into it are from off-campus.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #43

challenges.content: Off-campus?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #44

challenges.content: Yes, you know, people who use it in their work at hospitals, laboratories, even a police detective.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #45

challenges.content: Why did you choose Microbiology, if I may ask?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #46

challenges.content: I don't think you've quite answered that.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #47

challenges.content: Well, eventually I want to be a doctor.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #48

challenges.content: At least my dad tells me so.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #49

challenges.content: If I may say so, young lady, you seem a little uncertain.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #50

challenges.content: Still, I think that might be a good idea for a career.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #51

challenges.content: Of course, if you're thinking about being either a doctor or a vet,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #52

challenges.content: you should take some Medical Science classes before you even think of applying to med school.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #53

challenges.content: Great! What should I take?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #54

challenges.content: There is one small problem.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #55

challenges.content: The new Medical Sciences building is under construction,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #56

challenges.content: so there are no experimental facilities available until next year.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #57

challenges.content: I'm afraid you'll have to wait.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #58

challenges.content: But don't forget to take those courses at the first opportunity!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #59

challenges.content: Oh, bummer.
challenges.explanation:
bummer

a thing that is annoying or disappointing
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #60

challenges.content: Is there any other course you'd recommend for someone like me?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #61

challenges.content: Well, since you seem to like animals,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #62

challenges.content: have you ever thought about looking into Environmental Science?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #63

challenges.content: No, I never really thought about it before.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #64

challenges.content: Is it worthwhile?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #65

challenges.content: Quite! In fact, it's the fastest growing subject on this campus.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #66

challenges.content: I'm sorry, I couldn't help noticing the long list of classes you've written out there.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #67

challenges.content: May I have a look?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #68

challenges.content: Oh, sure.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #69

challenges.content: Medical Science, Statistics, Laboratory Techniques,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #70

challenges.content: Medicine, Mathematics, Computing.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #71

challenges.content: My, my, a bit of everything here.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #72

challenges.content: Is it too much?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #73

challenges.content: For your first semester, yes.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #74

challenges.content: What I suggest is starting out by taking the compulsory courses.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #75

challenges.content: Like we said before, the Medical Science can wait.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #76

challenges.content: Consider taking that in your sophomore year.
challenges.explanation:
sophomore year

Sophomore year is the second year of college or school. The first year is also called "freshman year".
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #77

challenges.content: I think I'd put off Computing, too.
challenges.explanation:
put off

If you put off an activity, you delay doing it or you do it later.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #78

challenges.content: I recommend to all freshmen that I talk to
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #79

challenges.content: to get the compulsory Mathematics out of the way as early as possible,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #80

challenges.content: so take that one.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #81

challenges.content: It'll be one less difficult course you have to focus on when the science lab opens next year,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #82

challenges.content: and you have to catch up on classes like Laboratory Techniques.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #83

challenges.content: Your major also requires Statistics so you have to balance two Math classes,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #84

challenges.content: and no doubt you should take that.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #85

challenges.content: Otherwise, get your required Medicine course out of the way by taking something theory-based.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #86

challenges.content: Oh, of course and your Environmental Science class if you're interested.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #87

challenges.content: The others can wait, though I think Computing is definitely a good idea,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #88

challenges.content: even though it's not required.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #89

challenges.content: I see too, on your paper there, you seem to have had high marks on the entrance exam.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #90

challenges.content: Uhhh, yeah. I guess so.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #91

challenges.content: Don't be shy! Have you thought about applying for a scholarship?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #92

challenges.content: Do they have any?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #93

challenges.content: I mean, my dad is always complaining about how much money it costs him.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #94

challenges.content: In your department, there are actually three full scholarships available.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #95

challenges.content: They cover tuition and provide $1,500 cash.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #96

challenges.content: $1,500 cash?! Party!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #97

challenges.content: Please, Miss. The money is intended more as a textbook allowance, not party money.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #98

challenges.content: If you promise to behave, I'll show you how to apply.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #99

challenges.content: Great, and thanks!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 3 - challenge #100

challenges.content: Good morning everyone,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #1

challenges.content: and welcome to the 2nd Annual Wullaballoo Conference on Mastering Computer Languages.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #2

challenges.content: I hope you all had a good trip.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #3

challenges.content: Before we get underway with today's programme,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #4

challenges.content: let me fill you in as to what's on tap for tomorrow,
challenges.explanation:
fill somebody in

give someone extra information

on tap

available
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #5

challenges.content: Sunday, February 19th.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #6

challenges.content: At 9 am right here in the Main Hall,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #7

challenges.content: we'll be hearing a lecture from Dr John Smith about "Computer as Teacher".
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #8

challenges.content: Professor Smith, from the University of Melbourne,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #9

challenges.content: is a world-class expert in the field of computer-assisted education,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #10

challenges.content: and his talk promises to be both stimulating and informative.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #11

challenges.content: Immediately afterwards, at 10:30,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #12

challenges.content: there'll be a presentation of papers by various delegates.
challenges.explanation:
delegates

Delegates are people that are chosen to speak in a meeting or conference.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #13

challenges.content: That, however, will take place in the Garden Room on the ground floor.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #14

challenges.content: If you don't yet know,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #15

challenges.content: the Garden Room is also called the Ballroom,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #16

challenges.content: and we'll be gathering at the west end,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #17

challenges.content: the slightly raised area called Level 2.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #18

challenges.content: Just look for the crowd.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #19

challenges.content: If you get lost, there are signs in the foyer.
challenges.explanation:
foyer

The foyer is the large area where people meet or wait just inside the main doors of a building such as a theatre, cinema, or hotel
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #20

challenges.content: After all that thinking, talking, and listening,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #21

challenges.content: I expect everyone will be a bit weary.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #22

challenges.content: So at 11:15,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #23

challenges.content: there will be a break for coffee, cookies, and other light refreshments.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #24

challenges.content: These will be available at the aptly named Refreshment Stand,
challenges.explanation:
aptly

If something is aptly done, it's done in a way that is appropriate.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #25

challenges.content: placed by the door back here in the Main Hall.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #26

challenges.content: Also, if you choose to skip the formal lunch,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #27

challenges.content: you can buy a packed lunch at the stand for a reasonable price.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #28

challenges.content: I strongly urge you, however, to join us at the formal lunch.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #29

challenges.content: That won't be till one o'clock sharp,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #30

challenges.content: so you have time to stroll about town a bit.
challenges.explanation:
stroll

to walk in a slow, relaxed way
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #31

challenges.content: We'll be eating at the Sea View Restaurant.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #32

challenges.content: The restaurant is located right here in the hotel, on the top floor.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #33

challenges.content: It's a good dozen flights of stairs,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #34

challenges.content: so I suggest you take the lift on the ground floor, eh?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #35

challenges.content: If you're not fond of fish,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #36

challenges.content: there's an all-you-can-eat barbecue available as well.
challenges.explanation:
all-you-can-eat

An all-you-can-eat meal is a meal where you can eat as much as you want.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #37

challenges.content: They even offer wallaby meat!
challenges.explanation:
wallaby

An animal in Australia that is similar to Kangaroo but smaller.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #38

challenges.content: After lunch, we'll troop back downstairs to Level 2 in the Ballroom
challenges.explanation:
troop

(a group of people) come or go together
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #39

challenges.content: for the presentation of further papers,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #40

challenges.content: which will begin at 2 pm.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #41

challenges.content: Please try to be on time.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #42

challenges.content: I know you'll be a bit tired after lunch,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #43

challenges.content: but the Ballroom echoes so with people coming in late.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #44

challenges.content: Thank you in advance.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #45

challenges.content: Once we've heard the papers,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #46

challenges.content: we'll break for afternoon tea at 3:10 p.m.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #47

challenges.content: No need to walk.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #48

challenges.content: The manager of the refreshment stand has graciously agreed to have tea served in the Ballroom.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #49

challenges.content: He's even promised us some special scones, baked from a recipe of his dear old Scottish grandmother.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #50

challenges.content: Then, tea being drunk and scones munched,
challenges.explanation:
munch

to eat something with a loud chewing sound
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #51

challenges.content: we'll retire here to the Main Hall for some closing remarks and questions.
challenges.explanation:
retire

leave a place and go to another
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #52

challenges.content: So, by 5 o'clock we should have the conference wrapped up.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #53

challenges.content: But the fun isn't over!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #54

challenges.content: This is Australia mates!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #55

challenges.content: We'll be flocking to the hotel's own Palm Lounge on the east side of the foyer for an informal reception.
challenges.explanation:
flock

to move together in a large group
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #56

challenges.content: You can relax, mingle with the other delegates, and let your hair down a bit.
challenges.explanation:
mingle

to move around and talk to other people

let your hair down

to enjoy yourself, to allow yourself to behave more freely
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #57

challenges.content: This will run from 5:10 to 6:10, though you're free to stay as long as you like.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #58

challenges.content: The lounge manager has informed me that, for the duration of the actual reception,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #59

challenges.content: you can have all-you-can-drink beer for $20 with purchase of an advance ticket.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #60

challenges.content: And, yes, tickets can be purchased from any conference organiser
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #61

challenges.content: or at the front desk anytime between now and the start of the reception.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #62

challenges.content: I suggest you come by tomorrow evening to pick up the tickets
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #63

challenges.content: since the conference hall only holds 800 people.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #64

challenges.content: That way, you can also get your journey planned ahead of time
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #65

challenges.content: and be sure not to miss this truly memorable conference.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #66

challenges.content: If you want cocktails, however, I'm sorry.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #67

challenges.content: You'll have to pay for those at the regular price.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #68

challenges.content: Oh my goodness! Speaking of paying,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #69

challenges.content: I see I forgot to tell you a couple of things.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #70

challenges.content: The first is about lunch.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #71

challenges.content: The charge for the lunch will be $15 for all you delegates.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #72

challenges.content: If you have guests with you,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #73

challenges.content: the cost is $25 for the general public,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #74

challenges.content: and $6.50 for children under the age of 10.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #75

challenges.content: That's $15 each, not total for everyone!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #76

challenges.content: Another item is about the lunch menu.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #77

challenges.content: I very much urge you to try the fish.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #78

challenges.content: I mean, look at the restaurant's name: Sea View.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #79

challenges.content: As the name suggests, it is a famous seafood restaurant.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #80

challenges.content: The chef is a Basque from Spain,
challenges.explanation:
Basque

The Basques are people from The Basque Country - a country that is located between France and Spain.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #81

challenges.content: and he really gets quite put out when people ignore his fish specialities for burgers or barbecue.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #82

challenges.content: If fish isn't your thing though, try the steak,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #83

challenges.content: he makes an exquisite Filet mignon topped with bleu cheese and mushrooms.
challenges.explanation:
exquisite

extremely beautiful and, typically, delicate
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #84

challenges.content: Finally, if you'd like to buy a ticket,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #85

challenges.content: you can have both lunch and unlimited beer for $35.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #86

challenges.content: I should have mentioned that earlier,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #87

challenges.content: but I am a bit forgetful.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #88

challenges.content: Maybe I should avoid the beer after the conference, eh?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #89

challenges.content: Well, I've said my bit. Are there any questions?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 2 - challenge #90

challenges.content: Good morning, ma'am, and welcome to "Australia's Moving Experience"!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #1

challenges.content: How can I help you?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #2

challenges.content: Well, I... I hope you can help me. I'm so up in the air right now...
challenges.explanation:
up in the air

uncertain, confused, not knowing what to do.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #3

challenges.content: Just calm down, now.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #4

challenges.content: Let me guess: you're moving and it has you a little confused.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #5

challenges.content: That's it exactly.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #6

challenges.content: You see, I'm relocating to the United States next month
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #7

challenges.content: and I'm having a hard time getting organised.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #8

challenges.content: Here, fill out your name and address, and let me ask you a few questions.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #9

challenges.content: Oh, what should I call you?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #10

challenges.content: My name is Jane, Jane Bond.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #11

challenges.content: OK, Jane, first of all, what's your work phone number?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #12

challenges.content: In case I have any questions about things.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #13

challenges.content: My work phone is 94635550.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #14

challenges.content: But please try not to call me too often there.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #15

challenges.content: My boss hates personal calls.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #16

challenges.content: So does mine, ma'am, so does mine.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #17

challenges.content: And what address should we ship your things to?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #18

challenges.content: My new company is letting me stay temporarily
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #19

challenges.content: at 509 Clark House,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #20

challenges.content: that's C-L-A-R-K,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #21

challenges.content: 1137 University Drive in Seattle.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #22

challenges.content: Seattle? Beautiful city, I hear.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #23

challenges.content: Mountains right beside the ocean, almost.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #24

challenges.content: Cooler than Australia, too.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #25

challenges.content: OK, and when should we come pack your things?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #26

challenges.content: Ah... I guess that would be on Monday, March 11th.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #27

challenges.content: Do you want any help with an after-packing clean-up?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #28

challenges.content: We do that for a small additional charge.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #29

challenges.content: Yes, that would be helpful.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #30

challenges.content: I promised the landlord I'd give her the keys back by 5 pm on Thursday, the 14th.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #31

challenges.content: Great, we'll just schedule the clean-up for that day.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #32

challenges.content: That way, the place will smell clean and there'll be no dust.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #33

challenges.content: Well, you do think of everything!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #34

challenges.content: Oh, how much is this going to cost?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #35

challenges.content: Here is a list of our basic prices.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #36

challenges.content: Oh dear, this seems rather expensive!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #37

challenges.content: Yes ma'am, but you're paying for the best.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #38

challenges.content: We're careful and we're fast.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #39

challenges.content: Like we say, the only thing we break are speed records getting you moved.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #40

challenges.content: Well... maybe that's so...
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #41

challenges.content: Oh, I nearly forgot to tell you.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #42

challenges.content: I don't want my furniture shipped with me.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #43

challenges.content: I won't be looking for an apartment till after I arrive in America.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #44

challenges.content: Would it be possible to put my furniture in storage here for a month,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #45

challenges.content: then have it sent along later?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #46

challenges.content: Of course, we do that all the time.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #47

challenges.content: A couple of other things.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #48

challenges.content: Here at "A Moving Experience", we try to pack your things logically.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #49

challenges.content: We don't just throw stuff in boxes.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #50

challenges.content: Do you have any special requests?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #51

challenges.content: You know, things you want packed in some special place,
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #52

challenges.content: so you know where to find them?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #53

challenges.content: Like what?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #54

challenges.content: Oh, I don't know... Things like dishes maybe.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #55

challenges.content: Not to be rude, but you look like a lady who likes to eat.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #56

challenges.content: Ahhh! Yes, I need my dishes and things where I can find them quickly.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #57

challenges.content: Great. We'll put those dishes and cutlery in what we call the emergency pack.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #58

challenges.content: Can you think of anything else?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #59

challenges.content: Ummm, I do have an antique tea kettle my great-grandmother gave my mother.
challenges.explanation:
antique

If something is antique, it's very old, usually it has a high value because it's beautiful, rare or high quality.

an antique tea kettle
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #60

challenges.content: I wouldn't want to lose that.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #61

challenges.content: So I guess you'd better put that in storage with the furniture.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #62

challenges.content: Grandma's tea kettle with the furniture, got it!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #63

challenges.content: Say, how about things like your alarm clock?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #64

challenges.content: You don't want to miss your plane on the big day, right?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #65

challenges.content: Well, you certainly think of everything!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #66

challenges.content: Yes, that's right.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #67

challenges.content: I'll also need my alarm clock where I can find it.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #68

challenges.content: Fine, we'll put that in your personal package.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #69

challenges.content: And of course, we'll give you a list of where we pack everything.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #70

challenges.content: So, all you'll have to do on Thursday, the 14th, is grab your luggage on your way out the door.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #71

challenges.content: Um, I couldn't help noticing the new CD player you're carrying.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #72

challenges.content: Is that a Samsung?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #73

challenges.content: Why? Yes, it is.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #74

challenges.content: One of their best.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #75

challenges.content: Cost me nearly a hundred dollars, it did!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #76

challenges.content: Do you want to take special care of it?
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #77

challenges.content: I mean it's brand new.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #78

challenges.content: Take care of it, but nothing special.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #79

challenges.content: You can just put it in storage with the furniture.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #80

challenges.content: That looks like everything we need here.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #81

challenges.content: I guess you're all set.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #82

challenges.content: That was certainly quick.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #83

challenges.content: Thank you, young man.
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #84

challenges.content: This has been a most moving experience!
challenges.discussionName: IELTS Recent Actual Test 29 - Part 1 - challenge #85
